# resilience

Timeouts before retries, retry with backoff+jitter, circuit breaker and bulkhead - the AWS Builders' Library canon behind the AF-RES family and AF-PERF-005/007.

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AF-RES-HEURISTIC` | diagnostic: resilience signals are pattern-matched; absence of a match is a blind spot, not proof of absence |
